tasks.short: Research urban green space requirements and impacts

steps.what: Define the research question, site context and search criteria for urban green spaces
Research technical requirements and environmental impacts by screening and extracting source findings

loop.purpose: Assist publication screening and extract relevant findings with provenance.
loop.input: Research scope and publications retrieved through the specified searches.
loop.output: Evidence table containing passages, study conditions, measures and gaps.
loop.check: Scientist verifies each retained finding against the publication, checks applicability and examines excluded borderline studies for missed evidence.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction per source; unavailable text or uncertain interpretation returns to manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native saved searches first; study descriptions and impact measures need contextual reading.

steps.what: Judge evidence quality and applicability before explaining green space requirements and impact uncertainties

tasks.design: Configure saved searches in the research reference environment {OTHER}, then use bounded screening and extraction to prepare a source-linked table. The scientist checks the sources and writes the site-specific assessment in {DOCS}; structural design and regulatory determinations remain separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence about substrates, vegetation and water effects is dispersed across studies with different conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Screening and extraction tools can organise candidate findings with source references.
tasks.still_hard: Research from another climate or roof system may not transfer to the intended site.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist judges evidence relevance and distinguishes measured impacts from extrapolation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated extraction; scientific conclusions and professional boundaries stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Explain evidence limits and identify requirements needing structural or other specialist assessment.

evidence.claim: Elicit supports evidence screening and extraction; its vendor time-saving claim is not a measured result for urban green space research.
This workflow and its conservative savings are model knowledge, not a task-specific benchmark.

assumptions: Boundary is literature-based technical and impact research, excluding structural design, permits and site experiments.

Scientist produces question, site/climate context, search terms, date limits, eligibility criteria and required evidence fields in s1. During s2 the native search retrieves publications with title, identifier and accessible text before extraction; retrieval and source checking remain counted within its remaining time. Missing full text triggers manual review.
OTHER means research reference environment. Native saved searches precede model screening; no source is invented.
unknowns: Existing review workflow and relevant site context
research_questions: Does a checked sample expose missed studies or findings from noncomparable roof and climate conditions?

already_counted.description: Retrieval, extraction verification and borderline study checks.

incremental.description: Maintain eligibility examples and review extraction failures.
Research librarian maintains reference access and source metadata support.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=87.75 gross=12.25 net=6.25 after 6 upkeep. Zero for inaccessible or poorly comparable studies; 2 for a modest reusable evidence table with unchanged scientific interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct bee disease and nectar yield experiments

steps.what: Conduct experiments on bee diseases and nectar or pollen yields while checking biological context

tasks.design: Retain biological experiment execution and causal interpretation with the scientist, recording observations in {DOCS}. Existing measurement equipment assists the work, while colony and environmental variation require direct scientific evaluation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disease, forage and environmental conditions interact in ways that demand controlled investigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing protocols support observation without removing physical experiments.
tasks.still_hard: Colony differences and changing forage conditions can confound apparent effects.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises competing causes and chooses appropriate follow-up experiments.
tasks.altitude: No assumed reduction in experimental effort or authority.

reach.learn: Distinguish disease mechanisms from environmental and colony-level confounding.

evidence.claim: Retaining biological experiments and interpretation is model knowledge; no applicable digest automation result is established.

assumptions: Boundary is experiment execution and interpretation, excluding animal-health treatment and unrelated routine laboratory testing.
Scientist produces observations and evaluates conditions during s1; no free structured disease classification or yield-cause flag is assumed.
Consider native measurement tools first. Unattended biological time is not human labour. Zero upkeep because no new workflow is proposed.
research_questions: Which design choices separate disease effects from colony and environmental differences?

already_counted.description: All biological experiment work and interpretation remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Physical experiments and scientific interpretation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify or classify insects and allied forms by examining specimens and diagnostic characteristics

tasks.design: Keep specimen examination and classification with the scientist, using references in {DOCS}. Existing identification keys support decisions, while damaged specimens and closely related taxa can require specialist review.
tasks.previous_blocker: Diagnostic features may be subtle, missing or dependent on specimen life stage.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference tools support classification without establishing a suitable automatic classifier here.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible visual match can overlook a decisive diagnostic difference.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist recognises limits and escalates uncertain identifications.
tasks.altitude: No assumed change in examination or identification workload.

reach.learn: Provide diagnostic observations and preserve uncertainty at the appropriate taxonomic level.

evidence.claim: Retaining specimen-based classification is model knowledge; no applicable validated image-identification capability appears in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is specimen examination and classification, excluding collection and distribution analysis.
Scientist produces diagnostic observations during s1; no structured feature vector or verified species label is assumed in advance.
Consider native identification keys first. Zero upkeep because no new automation or capture process is introduced.
research_questions: Which features must be directly observed before a species-level identification is justified?

already_counted.description: All examination and taxonomic judgement remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 gross=0 net=0. Specimen examination remains unchanged without assuming image recognition establishes species identity.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study insect distribution and recommend spread prevention

steps.what: Study insect occurrence and habitat evidence and reconcile geographic analysis inputs
Map verified occurrences and calculate specified distribution summaries in the geographic information system
Interpret distribution uncertainty and recommend methods to prevent importation or spread of injurious species

tasks.design: Configure native map views and summaries in the geographic information system {OTHER} from the scientist's checked occurrence dataset. Retain sampling-bias interpretation and prevention recommendations in {DOCS}, with no automatic movement restriction or treatment decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recurring map preparation repeated joins and summary settings across reviewed occurrence records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved map projects can replay explicit geographic transformations.
tasks.still_hard: Absence of observations may indicate absent sampling rather than absent insects.
tasks.human_edge: The scientist distinguishes observed distribution from inferred risk and selects proportionate advice.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated map construction; scientific interpretation and advisory authority stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Communicate sampling gaps and distinguish evidence from precautionary assumptions.

evidence.claim: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service supplies land-cover and land-use data usable as habitat context; it does not identify insect occurrences or spread risks.
Saved geographic summaries and the labour estimates are model knowledge, not a measured insect surveillance result.

assumptions: Boundary includes distribution study and advice, excluding separately scoped species identification and implementation of restrictions or interventions.

In s1 scientist produces record IDs, verified taxon references, dates, coordinates, coordinate system, observation effort, sampling gaps, habitat layer versions, exclusions and selected map/summary settings. Capture and checking remain counted; uncertain records return to manual investigation before mapping.
Spread pathway evidence is gathered and checked by the scientist during retained s3 before any recommendation. OTHER means geographic information system; native saved views precede custom code.
unknowns: Sampling effort coverage and existing mapping automation
research_questions: Does the map distinguish unsampled areas from genuinely surveyed absence and preserve coordinate accuracy?

already_counted.description: Dataset reconciliation, pathway investigation and recommendation judgement.

incremental.description: Maintain map joins, coordinate checks and reference examples.
Geographic data steward maintains layer compatibility.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80 gross=20 net=13 after 7 upkeep. Zero if maps already derive natively from records; 3 for a modest repeated join and summary subset with unchanged field work.

role.altitude: Evidence extraction and repeated maps can shrink preparation while experiments, identification and prevention judgement remain scientific work.
reach: Coordinate uncertain taxonomy with entomologists and prevention advice with plant health professionals.
role.ambitious_version: A scientist who makes reusable evidence tables and maps without overstating what the underlying studies or sampling establish.
